_doc: Live training widget (src/ui/liveTraining.ts). autoModes: SimConfig.mode values where the setting 'auto' shows the widget (classic and the minion-free trainers stay off). missRangeU: an enemy minion that dies this close to the own champion without the own last hit counts as missed CS. farmStartSec / minSpanSec: CS@10 projection extrapolates from the first wave reaching the lane (not from 0:00) and stays hidden until minSpanSec of farming exist. windupSec / projectileSpeed / rangedFrom: delay between the attack command and the hit (ranged hits need flight time). hpWindowSec: HP history used to estimate the damage a minion takes per second. soonSec: 'soon' state when the kill window opens within this time. markRangeU: minions further from the own champion get no timing bar. defaultRank: first rank target.
